news.headline: Brookline Capital Markets Initiates Coverage with Buy Rating, C$1.54 Price Target
news.summary: Brookline Capital Markets started coverage of Perimeter (TSXV:PINK; OTCQX:PYNKF) with a Buy rating and a C$1.54 (US$1.11) price target, versus a C$0.32 close on July 13. The target is based on a 10-year DCF assuming sharp 2026 uptake of Claire OCT followed by steady growth toward 9%+ lumpectomy penetration by 2035.

news.headline: Claire vs. the Competition: How Perimeter's Device Stacks Up Against a New Rival and the Old Standby
news.summary: An independent investor analysis compared Perimeter's newly FDA-approved Claire OCT+AI to Dilon Technologies' MarginProbe 2, a rival real-time margin-assessment device that received FDA clearance in December 2025 and posted 76.8% sensitivity in its U.S. pivotal trial, as well as to routine cavity shaving. The piece framed the competitive stakes for reducing breast-cancer lumpectomy reoperation rates as Claire begins its U.S. commercial rollout.

news.headline: Paradigm Capital Names Perimeter a New Healthcare Top Pick
news.summary: Paradigm Capital named Perimeter a new Top Pick with a speculative buy rating and C$0.95 price target, versus a C$0.275 close on July 3. The analyst cited the March 2026 FDA PMA approval of Claire as positioning the company to accelerate commercial rollout and draw more market interest.

news.headline: Perimeter CEO Presents Commercial Strategy and Milestones at Planet MicroCap Showcase in Las Vegas
news.summary: CEO Adrian Mendes presented a company update on Perimeter's current commercial strategy for Claire OCT+AI and discussed upcoming milestones at the Planet MicroCap Showcase, with a live and archived webcast made available to investors.

news.headline: INOVAIT Selects Perimeter for Contribution to Advance AI for Breast Cancer Surgery
news.summary: Perimeter was selected to receive up to nearly C$148,000 from the INOVAIT Pilot Fund, plus an additional $100,000 Mitacs Business Strategy Internship award, to advance next-generation AI capabilities for its flagship Claire OCT+AI device.

catalysts.when: CMS decision expected effective Jan 1, 2027 (Oct 1, 2026 possible but unlikely)
catalysts.label: CMS New Technology APC / MEARIS reimbursement decision
catalysts.detail: Perimeter is pursuing Medicare reimbursement for Claire via CMS's New Technology APC pathway under the MEARIS quarterly filing process, aided by Claire's FDA Breakthrough Device designation. A June 2026 MEARIS filing points to a most-likely effective date of January 1, 2027 for a new HCPCS code, with first Medicare/Medicare Advantage claims expected in Q1 2027; no official CMS decision has been confirmed yet.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Perimeter has not yet announced a specific date for its Q2 2026 (quarter ended June 30) earnings release and conference call as of Aug 8, 2026; third-party estimate trackers show unconfirmed placeholder dates ranging from late Aug to Sep 2026.

catalysts.label: Continued commercial rollout of Claire OCT+AI amid rising competition
catalysts.detail: Following March 2026 FDA PMA approval, Perimeter is scaling commercial placements of Claire across existing hospital relationships (e.g., Intermountain Health, Medical City Dallas) and pursuing new health-system agreements, while facing a newly FDA-cleared rival device (Dilon Technologies' MarginProbe 2); incremental placement/adoption announcements are a recurring near-term catalyst.

pulse: Perimeter continues commercializing its FDA-approved Claire OCT+AI device for intraoperative breast-cancer margin assessment, with sell-side attention building: Paradigm Capital (Top Pick, C$0.95 target) and Brookline Capital Markets (Buy, C$1.54 target) both initiated bullish coverage in early-to-mid July 2026, even as independent analysts flag a newly FDA-cleared competitor (Dilon's MarginProbe 2) entering the same margin-assessment market. The stock trades around US$0.21 (~C$0.29) as of early August 2026, with no major company-specific news since mid-July, leaving the pending CMS New Technology APC/MEARIS reimbursement decision (likely effective January 2027) and the still-undated Q2 2026 earnings release as the key near-term catalysts to watch.
